name: cross-field-list-constraints
body: A list field may declare `max_items_from` and `min_items_from`, each naming another list field: `max_items_from` bounds this list to at most the named list's item count, and `min_items_from` bounds it to at least the named list's item count. A leading `/` names a top-level field of the template; a bare name names a sibling field within the same record (record-item-type). A violation is a single error naming both fields and both lengths.
